messages.author: 7cec1ca129682d1f
messages.subject: dataProcess file export
parts:
Hi --

Is there a way to export a .csv file that contains the results of the dataProcess command? I need the values that are graphed in the condition plot, so I can plot the graphs in Prism.

Thanks,
Scott

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: dataProcess file export
parts:
Hi,

there is no specific function for that. Output of dataProcess has two slots accessible via $: FeatureLevelData and ProteinLevelData. Both are simply data.frame and can be exported using typical functions for that purpose such as write.table, fwrite, write_csv etc.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
